Reassembly of new 5th speed selector fork.

1. Lock the sleeve in the vice, with protective plates fitted;

2. Position the selector fork so that the tapered end is in the same direction as that of the sleeve, resting it against the side of the sleeve with the smaller diameter;

fit the selector fork manually, exerting the necessary pressure, until it is completely engaged in the hub.

When it is fitted, check that the sleeve can rotate freely inside the selector fork.
